elevation_basis: the antenna elevation is absent from the locations feed and from the WMO registry its detail link names (probed 2026-08-12: totalCount 0), so it is read from the volumes instead: ODIM carries the antenna height above mean sea level at /where/height in every polar volume. Harvested by tools/harvest_radar_heights.py, one whole file per site, each one cross-checked against this table's own position for that site so a height cannot be read out of another radar's file. A site the harvest could not reach keeps null and stays refused, because a placeholder does not make a site usable, it makes an unusable site look usable
